analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 45.0에서 46.6으로 소폭 상승했으나 여전히 중립 구간이며, MACD 히스토그램은 -1.2292에서 -1.8137로 악화되어 하락 압력이 지속되고 있다. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.17배로 위축되어 방향성 판단에 신뢰도를 더하기 어렵다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for the third consecutive day. RSI slightly increased from 45.0 to 46.6 but remains in neutral territory, while the MACD histogram worsened from -1.2292 to -1.8137, indicating persistent downward pressure. Trading volume at 0.17x the 5-day average is subdued, further reducing confidence in directional conviction.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($719.76/$700.03) — Confirms maintenance of medium-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (84.0%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.0→46.6) + Neutral assessment + Interpreted as persistent downward pressure.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2292→-1.8137) + Worsening diagnosis + Absence of trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $748.86) + Bandwidth at 3.44% interpreted as normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($734.97) + Basis (Lower BB, near Pivot S1).
· Swing Resistance ($753.02) + Breakthrough expected to lead to short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Sideways) + Sideways trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.17x) + Interpreted as reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + Specifies conditions for observation.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 5일 고가/저가 패턴이 뚜렷한 방향성을 보이지 않고 있다. MACD 히스토그램 악화가 지속되는 점은 하방 압력을 시사한다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The price is consolidating near the Bollinger Band middle line, and the 5-day high/low pattern shows no clear direction. The continued worsening of the MACD histogram suggests downward pressure.
